name: shotcraft-tracking-expand

description: Quiet concept or chapter opening with a short title; keep the camera still.
author: WeiYihao; iPolloWork integration

upstream.adaptation: Remotion frame interpolation ported to paused HyperFrames/GSAP with original pure easing functions; absolute cues reanchored to narration. Demo skeletons replaced by real content variables and theme tokens. Not a pixel-identical native Remotion render.

ai.instructions: Quiet concept or chapter opening with a short title; keep the camera still. Not a replacement for technical diagrams or a long narrated scene. Use at most two title entrance families per video.

events.action: Expand compressed characters into a stable title
Reveal a supporting phrase after the main title settles

useWhen: Quiet concept or chapter opening with a short title; keep the camera still.
avoidWhen: Not a replacement for technical diagrams or a long narrated scene. Use at most two title entrance families per video.

inputRules.title: One short title, 1–8 characters; no paragraphs or line breaks.
inputRules.subtitle: One supporting phrase, at most 24 characters. Do not repeat the title.

readingOrder: Expand compressed characters into a stable title
Reveal a supporting phrase after the main title settles

cueBindings.expand: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Expand compressed characters into a stable title. Do not estimate from text length.
cueBindings.subtitle: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Reveal a supporting phrase after the main title settles. Do not estimate from text length.

fallback.overflow: Split at a semantic boundary or choose a suitable recipe. Do not shrink or truncate text.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve required content and real assets; report a gap instead of using placeholder graphics.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured phrases while preserving original movement ratios and final hold. Split the scene if it does not fit.
fallback.inapplicable: Select another proven recipe; with recipes-only policy, report the library gap rather than author custom graphics.

example.narration: 先认识反馈回路，再看它怎样改变结果。

acceptance: Every action changes the real target and reverse seeking restores the same picture.
Use actual content, measured fonts and validated project-local media.
Preserve original movement functions, geometry and ordering; the final state remains readable.
